messages:
sahil: Quick bakeoff update — ran FP8 / AWQ / GPTQ across the new llm-onboard suite for llama-2-70b and a 10k prompt eval. TL;DR: AWQ int8 gives ~1.8% avg accuracy drop vs fp16, GPTQ ~2.5% but smaller size, FP8 appears near-fp16 on short contexts but shows degradation on >4k. Latency: AWQ decode throughput +25% vs GPTQ; FP8 latency similar to FP16 for our kernels but memory footprint is better.

jenna: Can you drop the perf table + the packaging manifest? Need p50/p95 and exact accuracy deltas.

sahil: pasted below — small table and proposed manifest snippet.

sahil: ```
perf: {
  model: 'llama-2-70b',
  dataset: 'onboard-suite-v3',
  metrics: {p50_ms: {fp16: 180, awq: 145, gptq: 130, fp8: 175}, p95_ms: {fp16: 420, awq: 360, gptq: 340, fp8: 410}},
  accuracy_delta: {awq: '-1.8%', gptq: '-2.5%', fp8: "-0.6% on short vs -3.1% on >4k"}
}
```

sahil: ```
{'profile_name':'optpkg/llama2-70b/awq/v0.1','quant_backend':'awq','dtype':'int8','accuracy_delta':'-1.8%','intents':['cost_saver','batchable'],'kernel_hint':'gemm-packed','fallback':'fp16','rollback_threshold':'2.0%'}
```

alex: LGTM. Naming suggestion: stick to "optpkg/<model>/<backend>/v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>-<intent>". Keep intent short: lowlatency | lowcost | highacc. Example: optpkg/llama2-70b/awq/v1.0-lowcost

maria: Add these to manifest: sha256 model artifact, tokenizer compatibility tag, quantization seed+config (per-layer), and a validation checksum for eval set. Also ensure the manifest contains a safe_fallback boolean and a max_context_tokens hint.

ops-bot: Staging check: awq artifact size 17GB, passes size limit. Canary rollout recommendation: 5% traffic -> monitor accuracy_detector metric -> escalate if delta > 2.0% for 30m.

jenna: For Redwood Optimize UI — we should surface: cost_per_token_estimate, latency_p50/p95, accuracy_delta_vs_fp16, recommended_profile (intent), and fallback_policy link. Also allow toggling kernel_hint and a simulate-decode quick test.

sahil: Agreed. Final naming we lock: optpkg/llama2-70b-awq/v1.0-lowcost. I'll push manifest to registry and add a short readme about when to prefer awq vs gptq vs fp8.

jenna: Perfect, assign to me to add registry entry and audit CI gates.

alex: :thumbsup:
